{{Quote|They're probably not answering because they don't understand you. ''[&hellip;]'' As I said, they're from the same region of space I am, and we don't know the language of the mighty and noble Vagaari.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''You will soon learn it. The '''Vagaari language''' was a language spoken by the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. ''Amacrisier'' was an order commanding one's forces to cease their fire in the language.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>
